intro: {{count}} published MBA / PGDM colleges in Telangana have a recorded average package higher than their recorded total fee. This list of the best MBA / PGDM colleges in Telangana where average package exceeds fees starts with NIT Warangal, then Hyderabad colleges.

NIT Warangal is listed with MBA Finance at ₹1.335 lakh and a 2023 average of ₹17 lakh. Its card also shows a highest package of ₹88 lakh, and an older NIRF figure of 100 that we have not treated as a 2025 rank.
Ten of the {{published}} colleges are in Hyderabad and one is in Warangal. Most Hyderabad fees are modest, and several may be annual figures.
listLead: These are the top MBA / PGDM colleges in Telangana 2026 on this value filter. After NIT Warangal, the Hyderabad names overlap with our Hyderabad city article, including Osmania University departments.
snapshot: Across {{feeN}} colleges with a recorded fee, the median total is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half sits between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}.
{{private}} colleges are private and {{public}} are public. Every recorded average on this list is from {{pkgYearMin}}.
TS ICET is the most common recorded test, with CAT appearing at fewer colleges. The highest recorded package is {{highestMax}}, at NIT Warangal, which is one 2023 offer, not the ₹17 lakh average.
firstCollegesLead: Osmania University's Department of Business Management is listed with MBA in Technology Management at ₹40,000 and a 2023 average of ₹8 lakh. Confirm the official general MBA fee if that is your course.
Sri Indu College, which also appears on the Hyderabad list, has a recorded MBA fee of ₹27,000. Treat that as a prompt to check whether the official notice is annual.

sections.heading: NIT Warangal and the Hyderabad cluster
paragraphs: NIT Warangal's 2023 average of ₹17 lakh sits well above the Hyderabad private-college averages of about ₹4–8 lakh in our records. Compare official reports, not only our cards.
CMR College of Engineering & Technology has a recorded highest package of ₹58 lakh against a ₹4 lakh average in 2023. Use the average, and the official report, when you plan.

compare.heading: How to judge the best MBA / PGDM colleges in Telangana where average package exceeds fees
paragraphs: A National Institute MBA and an affiliated-college MBA can both pass this filter and still differ sharply in official fees, tests and batch size.
bullets: The official two-year MBA fee, especially where our figure is under ₹1 lakh.

faqs.question: How many MBA colleges in Telangana have an average package above fees?
faqs.answer: We list {{published}} published colleges in Telangana on this filter. A college needs both a recorded fee and a recorded average package to appear.

faqs.question: What was NIT Warangal's recorded average package?
faqs.answer: Our records show a 2023 average of ₹17 lakh for the MBA Finance card, and a highest package of ₹88 lakh. The highest figure is one offer, not a typical package, and it is not a guarantee.

faqs.question: Do most Telangana colleges on this list take TS ICET?
faqs.answer: TS ICET is the most frequently recorded test here, and CAT appears at fewer colleges, including NIT Warangal. Confirm the latest admission route in the official brochure.

faqs.question: Why do some Telangana MBA fees look very low?
faqs.answer: The median recorded total is {{feeMedian}}. Some Hyderabad affiliated-college figures may be annual. Check the official fee notice before you treat them as a two-year cost.

faqs.question: Are the placement figures guaranteed?
faqs.answer: No. Every recorded average on this Telangana list is from {{pkgYearMin}}. Use the college's latest official placement report.
